farmer.text: Come here, my dear, sit next to me. I will tell you a beautiful story from the Quran.

zainab.text: Come, my little one, sit with us. I have a lovely story for you about patience.

hamdan.text: Welcome, young friend! The caravan has just arrived from the market. Let me tell you about a great journey.

amina.text: What a wonderful question! Listen to the story from the beginning, and you will find the answer yourself.

player.text: Grandpa, please tell me the story! I love the stories of the Quran so much.

narrator.text: Let's begin a new adventure! Walk to the next house in the village, someone is waiting for you.
